room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day; associated medical expenses proportionally capped if higher room taken

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: 20% co-pay applies to every claim; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI; room rent and ICU also sub-limited

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions except HIV/AIDS

specific_disease_waiting.note: 19 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, hysterectomy, ENT disorders, calculi, varicose veins etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of Sum Insured as inpatient or day-care

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items explicitly excluded (Annexure II List I)

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days for yearly premium payment; 15 days for monthly instalment mode

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals

portability.note: Portability to same product of other insurers as per IRDAI guidelines

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary treatment, organ donor hospitalisation, treatment outside India, STDs/venereal disease, maternity, ART for HIV, stem cell storage, OPD treatment
optional_riders: Co-pay waiver (additional premium to remove 20% co-pay)
